clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa, Grull Hawkwind guides young tauren through their first trials. As Chief Hawkwind’s son, he prepares hunters and warriors to test their resolve and honor their ancestors.

At Camp Narache, Grull Hawkwind helps prepare the tribe’s youth. The son of Chief Hawkwind, he guides new arrivals on Red Cloud Mesa and judges whether they are ready to serve the Shu'halo. He sets trials of stamina, tracking, and survival against plainstriders and mountain cougars. Through these trials, young tauren learn that balance and respect for nature are foundations of life in Mulgore.
